BackstoryDef.title: Haafingar fisher's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up hauling nets on the frozen coast below Solitude. [PAWN_possessive] family whispered about the old castle out in the Sea of Ghosts and told [PAWN_objective] never to row toward it.

BackstoryDef.title: Honorhall orphan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years in the Honorhall Orphanage in Riften, learning to steal bread and keep quiet. [PAWN_pronoun] slipped away one night and never went back.

BackstoryDef.title: Bruma shepherd
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] herded goats in the Jerall Mountains above Bruma. Long nights alone on the slopes taught [PAWN_objective] patience and a healthy fear of what moves in the dark.

BackstoryDef.title: temple acolyte
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] swept the halls of a temple to Arkay and learned the rites for the dead. [PAWN_pronoun] can still recite them, though [PAWN_pronoun] no longer finds any comfort in them.

BackstoryDef.title: noble's ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised as the ward of a minor Colovian noble, taught letters, manners and swordplay. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early how to please powerful people.

BackstoryDef.title: Karthwasten miner's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the silver mines of the Reach, where the tunnels were dark and the Forsworn were never far away. [PAWN_pronoun] can see in poor light better than most.

BackstoryDef.title: Volkihar courtier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent decades at the feasting table of Castle Volkihar, trading favors and venom with the other vampires of the court. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to flatter a lord and how to ruin one.

BackstoryDef.title: clan enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dealt with the Volkihar's problems: debtors, deserters and Dawnguard scouts who got too close. [PAWN_pronoun] rarely needed to be told twice.

BackstoryDef.title: blood-starved fledgling
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was turned only a few years ago and has never fully mastered the thirst. [PAWN_pronoun] still remembers sunlight, and still wakes some evenings expecting to see it.

BackstoryDef.title: devotee of Molag Bal
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sought out Molag Bal willingly and paid for the gift in blood. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks of Coldharbour the way other people speak of home.

BackstoryDef.title: fallen Vigilant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once hunted daedra worshippers as a Vigilant of Stendarr. A vampire got to [PAWN_objective] first. [PAWN_pronoun] knows every ward and every trick [PAWN_possessive] old order uses.

BackstoryDef.title: cave-dweller
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived for years in a cave with a pack of feral vampires, feeding on whatever wandered in. [PAWN_pronoun] has forgotten most of what [PAWN_pronoun] knew about polite company.

BackstoryDef.title: blood scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has spent a long unlife studying the nature of vampirism, chasing rumors of Vampire Lords and the cure alike. [PAWN_possessive] notes fill whole chests.

BackstoryDef.title: night bard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] performed in taverns across Skyrim, always after dark. Audiences loved [PAWN_objective], though a few of them were never quite the same afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: castle steward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the halls of a vampire stronghold running: the thralls fed, the cattle penned and the lord's guests seated in order of rank.

BackstoryDef.title: turned Dawnguard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rode with the Dawnguard until a hunt went wrong. Now [PAWN_pronoun] knows exactly what [PAWN_possessive] old comrades will do when they find [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: blood cattle
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was kept in the pens beneath a vampire stronghold and bled whenever the lord was thirsty. Most of [PAWN_possessive] will has been worn away.

BackstoryDef.title: household thrall
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served a vampire household by day, guarding the coffins and running errands in the sunlight that [PAWN_possessive] masters could not.

BackstoryDef.title: thrall guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood watch over a vampire lair while [PAWN_possessive] masters slept. [PAWN_pronoun] would die for them without a second thought.

BackstoryDef.title: willing servant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] offered [PAWN_objective]self to the Volkihar in hopes of being turned someday. So far [PAWN_pronoun] has only been fed upon.

BackstoryDef.title: grave digger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dug graves for a vampire coven and filled them too. The work never bothered [PAWN_objective] as much as it should have.
